fact: The Ministry of Communications and Innovation says the government continues to expand high-speed internet access to rural communities, schools and healthcare facilities through the Village Connectivity Project.

The Universal Access and Service Fund subsidises communications services in unserved and underserved areas and ran 2024-25 projects for 4G mobile networks and broadband internet in rural areas, with a 2029 goal of 100% rural connectivity.
The Universal Access and Service Fund reports 51 more villages given 4G mobile network connectivity in 2024-25, bringing 279 villages connected by March 2025, plus 37 highway sites.
Giga says the government has committed to connecting every village with more than 500 residents and has financed 100% of infrastructure deployment through its national broadband provider BoFiNet.
Minister Segokgo says the government's village connectivity project, aimed at over 500 villages, had in its first phase connected 1,138 public facilities across 144 villages.
